“the stakes for our movement has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our movement have never been higher”
“federal goverment” >>> “federal government”
“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”
“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are stated, but only two are named.]
“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”
“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”
“In brief, the bill:” >>> “In brief, the bill contains the following provisions:”
“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”
“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”
“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier.]
“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”
“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The earlier summary gives a maximum daily civil penalty of $1 million; confirm the amount and whether the amendment keeps or changes it.]
“who's support” >>> “whose support”
“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”
“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”
“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These counts total 29, not the stated 28 committee members.]
“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: Five senators are listed, but the preceding sentence says six are undecided. Also clarify whether Kowalski and Ames, whose positions are discussed below, belong in this list or another vote category.]
“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”
“a seperate interview” >>> “a separate interview”
“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”
“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”
“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”
“occured” >>> “occurred”
“The committee's hearing on the impacts of deep-sea mining occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: The vote discussion references a September 23 hearing. Confirm whether these are separate hearings or one date is incorrect.]
“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary specifies 18 months, not two years. Also confirm whether the requirement is to negotiate or to conclude an agreement.]
“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”
“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”
“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”
“recieve updated talking points” >>> “receive updated talking points”
“Each of our five field organizers” >>> [CHECK: The paragraph begins with six field organizers.]
